Sign in to appear on the board. Only your name, island % and roads completed are shown.
Sign in to add your progress. Only your name, island % and roads completed are shown.
This board is for roads. Trails have their own board in Bainbridge Trails.
We sync which road sections you’ve covered — never your GPS track or walk times. Your public name is a random one unless you choose your own.

We store your account id, your public name, and which road sections you’ve covered (as on/off flags per 5 m of road). From those we compute your island % and roads completed for the leaderboard.
Others see only your name, island % and roads completed — never your GPS track or walk times. Use a random name if you prefer.
